meta.title: Headroom Compression
meta.description: Context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses large, stale history through the local Headroom proxy before it reaches the model, and mounts the Headroom MCP tools (headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve, headroom_stats).

markerWithHash: [headroom] This content was compressed for the model ({before} → {after} tokens). The original is retrievable with mcp__headroom__headroom_retrieve using hash "{hash}".
markerNoHash: [headroom] This content was compressed for the model ({before} → {after} tokens).
